column1: # GhostLock GLKv3 owner-qualified manifest (GLKv3 schema 3 / generated form R2).
# The wire column may be a "|"-separated UNION of wire kinds (the S4 P1
# dynamic plugin paths plugin.<id>.params.* / plugin.<id>.extract.*); every
# member must come from the wire-kind vocabulary and an unknown member is
# rejected fail-closed (the Kotlin adapter parses the same union).
# Dynamic paths resolve their concrete type from the plugin descriptor
# (probe TSV param/extract rows), whose type literals are these same kinds.

column7: Vendor carrier absolute path; absent = first device-present default.
Kernel module interface, encoded major*1000 + minor.
late-load argument policy bitmask; 0 = program + late-load only.
LKM window handshake retry delay in ms; default 5.
Chain terminus wait budget in ms; default 15000.
Plugin enabled; default false, and only enabled=true is emitted.
Dynamic: P2 extractor writes it; P1 validates shape only.
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the module file.
Dynamic: type comes from the plugin descriptor (probe TSV param rows).
